entries.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation
Named built-in agent overrides and custom agent definitions
Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)
Default primary agent to use when no session agent is selected
Enable built-in formatters or configure formatter overrides
Additional paths or URLs supplying ambient instructions
Enable built-in language servers or configure server overrides
Maximum bytes of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 51200)
Maximum lines of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 2000)
Default model to use when no session or agent model is selected
Ordered tool permission rules applied to agent tool use
Ordered plugin enablement directives and external package declarations
Ordered policies controlling access to providers, tools, and integrations
Policy statements applied to supported resources, such as provider access

MCP protocol negotiation. "legacy" (default) opens with the initialize handshake and speaks protocol revisions up to 2025-11-25. "auto" probes for the 2026-07-28 revision and falls back to legacy when the server does not support it. "2026-07-28" requires that revision and fails otherwise.
Reuse a randomly selected provider until it is rate limited, then switch to another available provider.
Named local directories or Git repositories available as external context
Release date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM
Control whether sessions may be shared manually, automatically, or not at all
Default shell to use for terminal and shell tool execution
Additional paths or URLs to discover skills from
Enable snapshots used for undo and revert behavior
Disable updates, notify when one is available, or install updates automatically
Username displayed in conversations and used for telemetry identity
Keep recently active sessions warm with transient model requests (default: false)
Directory defaults for local worktree creation
